fills.sql:
select c.class_code, c.class_code || ' - ' || c.desc_a class_code__d,
       (select max(u.retail_sale_price) from st_item_unit u where u.group_code = :PARENT_GROUP_CODE
           and u.item_code = :PARENT_ITEM_CODE and u.unit_code = :PARENT_UNIT_CODE) sales_price,
       (select max(i.moh_disc) from st_item i where i.item_group_code = :PARENT_GROUP_CODE and i.item_code = :PARENT_ITEM_CODE) disc_ratio1
  from ar_st_item_classes c
 where not exists (select 1 from ar_st_items_disc x where x.class_code = c.class_code
                      and x.item_group_code = :PARENT_GROUP_CODE and x.item_code = :PARENT_ITEM_CODE)
 order by c.class_code

notes: items (ST_ITEM.fmb): code = NVL(MAX(ITEM_CODE),0)+1 per group (first SUBSTR(group,1,5)||'0001'), transaction group allowed for the user group, stop flag from the group, uniqueness of alternative / Lemon / SMC codes, VAT 0 or 15 -> TX_TAXES_ITEMS, min/max limits, M.O.H discount, exactly one basic unit with factor 1, unique factors, units used in transactions locked, unique barcodes, alternative items; delete refused with transactions (lots, locations, balances rows removed); balance / cost panel

حقول إلزامية للصنف الجديد: نسبة الضريبة وسعر البيع المبدئي
validations.plsql: if :PAGE_VAT_VALUE is null then return case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then 'VAT % must be entered' else 'يجب إدخال نسبة الضريبة' end; end if; if :PAGE_INITIAL_SALES_PRICE is null then return case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then 'Initial sales price must be entered' else 'يجب إدخال سعر البيع المبدئي' end; end if; return null;

after_save.name: الوحدة الأساسية ومعاملات التحويل وضريبة الصنف

AR_ST_ITEMS_DISC.CLASS_CODE.lov: select class_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(desc_e, desc_a) else desc_a end d, class_code r from ar_st_item_classes order by class_code

ST_ITEM.ITEM_GROUP_CODE.lov: select g.item_group_code || ' - ' || g.name_a d, g.item_group_code r from st_item_group g where g.group_status = 1 and app_rules3_st.group_allowed(g.item_group_code) = 1 order by g.item_group_code

ST_ITEM.CLASS_CODE.lov: select c.class_code || ' - ' || c.desc_a d, c.class_code r from st_item_classes c order by c.class_code

ST_ITEM.COUNTRY_CODE.lov: select c.country_code || ' - ' || c.name_a d, to_char(c.country_code) r from st_org_country c order by c.country_code

ST_ITEM.ACTIVE_MATERIAL_CODE.lov: select m.serial || ' - ' || m.name_a d, m.serial r from st_active_material m order by m.serial

ST_ITEM_STORE_LOCATIONS.LOCATION_LABEL.lov: select l.location_label || ' - ' || l.desc_a d, l.location_label r from st_store_locations l where l.store_code = :PAGE_STORE_CODE order by l.location_label

ST_SUB_ITEM.SUB_ITEM_CODE.lov: select i.item_code || ' - ' || i.name_a d, i.item_code r from st_item i order by i.item_group_code, i.item_code

ST_ITEM_STORE_LOCATIONS.STAND_NAME.sql: (select max(l.desc_a) from st_store_locations l where l.store_code = t.store_code and l.location_label = t.location_label)

ST_SUB_ITEM.SUB_ITEM_NAME.sql: (select max(i.name_a) from st_item i where i.item_group_code = t.sub_item_group_code and i.item_code = t.sub_item_code)

ST_SUB_ITEM.SUB_GROUP_NAME.sql: (select max(g.name_a) from st_item_group g where g.item_group_code = t.sub_item_group_code)
